reader.requirement: At --std 85 a word, numeric literal or nonnumeric literal inside pseudo-text-1 or pseudo-text-2 of COPY REPLACING may be split across lines by a hyphen in the indicator area and is joined by the normal continuation rules (§1985:IV.7.2.2: intervening comment and blank lines skipped, a continued nonnumeric literal keeps its trailing spaces to margin R and resumes after the quotation mark), with area A of each continuation line blank and both characters of '==' on one line.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry fixed-form-text-in-area-a-2002: continuation text in area A refused (COBOL3735) at 85, allowed from 2002
dialectLevel < 2023 returns: word continuation accepted at 85, COBOL0902 (removed) at 2023
dialectLevel < 2023 returns: no obsolete flag for the column-7 hyphen at 85, COBOL0903 warning at 2023

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 word continuation in pseudo-text is legal and continuation text in area A is refused; at 2023 word continuation is removed (COBOL0902) and the hyphen is obsolete (COBOL0903)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f28_01 covers a word, a numeric literal and a nonnumeric literal ending at margin R; not intervening comment or blank lines, trailing-space literal content, nor the area-A and split-delimiter refusals

probes.expected: area A of the continuation line must be blank (§1985:IV.7.2.5)

reader.notes: Continuation is resolved in the reference-format logical-line builder before COPY/REPLACE see the text, so pseudo-text continuation is the ordinary fixed-form ContinueFixed join. The seed ContinueFloating is the 2002+ floating-indicator path, not taken at 85. Diagnostics at 85 cite §2023 clauses; cosmetic.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: rcp2.cob COPY REPLACING ==PIC-HERE== BY ==PIC X(1 / -2)== (a PICTURE character-string continued, the IV.7.2.2 form the reader did not try) and ==WS-ITEM== BY a word continued over THREE lines (WS- / -TH / -ING): exit 0, [ABC         ] (X(12) and WS-THING both formed). rcp4.cob a nonnumeric literal in pseudo-text-1 continued with its last character at margin R (col 72) and resumed after the quotation mark matches library literal "PQRSTUVW": [HIT     ]; rcp3.cob the same with the continued line ending at col 71 (one trailing space belongs to the literal per IV.7.2.2) does not match: [PQRSTUVW], correct. Also a continuation line following the opening delimiter (BY == / -"HIT"==) joined. rcp1.cob: pseudo-text-2 text X(3) written in area A (no hyphen) is refused COBOL3735; this is right at 85, not an over-reject: §1985:XII.2.4 GR9 places each pseudo-text-2 word in the resultant program in the area where it appears, so the PICTURE operand lands in area A. cite.py: OK §1985:XII.2.3 SR5; OK §1985:IV.7.2.2 ("All spaces at the end of the continued line are considered part of the literal"); OK §1985:XII.2.4 GR9 ("Each text word in pseudo-text-2 that is to be placed into the resultant program begins in the same area").
